{{dablink|For other uses of the words "arrow" and "fire," see [[Arrow]] and [[Fire (disambiguation)|Fire]].}}
'''Arrows of Fire''' is an intricate weave of [[Earth]] and [[Fire]] which causes small filaments of superheated material to fly from the channeler's fingertips.

==Use==
Each fingertip will fire ten of these very rapidly, so quickly they appear to flicker. The filaments kill by heating whatever material they come into contact with to beyond boiling, creating large holes in their targets. A single filament has the ability to vaporize its way through up to three [[Trolloc]]s. Up to one hundred of these filaments may be fired simultaneously.

Along with [[Deathgates]] and [[Blossoms of Fire]], Arrows of Fire are a recently rediscovered combat weave used by the [[Asha'man]]. [[Rand al'Thor]] learned these [[weave]]s when [[Lews Therin Telamon]] gained control of ''[[saidin]]'' in the [[Battle at Lord Algarin's manor]].{{ref/book|11|19}}
